text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived, and Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi entered the Senior Class—

New Year's Day. Accepting her invitation, 
I went on a Hatsumode visit with her 
today.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Happy New Year!
choice_data_list:
Congratulations. What're you wishing for, 
Tsuyoshi?

Congratulations. What are you going to 
wish for, Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Of course—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, watch out!! You shouldn't say 
what you're wishing for out loud! Haven't 
you heard it won't come true if you do?!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, sorry, sorry.

text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I can somewhat imagine it. And 
so, joining the line heading toward the 
worship hall—"
(Clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a strong Umamusume who 
can beat everyone, just like the 
President!

"...As I overhear the prayers spilling 
from beside me, I bring both of my hands 
together."
choice_data_list: And may you stay in good health.
And may you stay in good health.

(I pray that I can help make her 
stronger.)
...I want the skills to support her.
...I want the skills to support her.

text_block_list.text:
"...As I overhear the prayers spilling 
from beside me, I bring both of my hands 
together."
choice_data_list: And may you stay in good health.
And may you stay in good health.

(I pray that I can help make her 
stronger.)
...I want the skills to support her.
...I want the skills to support her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer... ...What do you mean by 
'And'...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Could it be you heard my prayers...?
choice_data_list:
Right! Let's say it's a prayer from the 
two of us!

Right! Let's say it's a prayer from the 
two of us!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Both of yours?

In that case, it makes sense that I'd know 
her wish. Even if her wish is heard, it's 
not like it won't come true anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ! I-I see...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're so smart!? How did you cover 
for me so quickly!? Huh!? So slick!!

"...And so, after finishing our shrine 
visit with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi."

Standing by her side, I make a vow. That 
this year will be even more fruitful than 
the last.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...You were praying for quite a long time, 
weren't you?
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi's the one

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Yes! It was my biggest wish of the 
year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Were you feeling that way too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...Are you curious about it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah... N-No, no, that's—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if I am curious, I can't ask. I 
don't want it to not come true, after 
all."

"...And so, after finishing our shrine 
visit with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi."

And so, just as I was about to step out of 
line—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer, stop right there! Please don't 
move a muscle!
choice_data_list: Huh, why?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ummm...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm so sorry! Excuse my ears!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I overheard your wish! You said, "I want 
the technique to support them"...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't mean to eavesdrop, okay?!
choice_data_list:
Haha, don't worry. That was a vow, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: A vow?
choice_data_list:
Right, a vow to make it come true through 
your own hard work.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...My wish is! 'To become a strong 
Umamusume who can beat everyone!' That's 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Ehehe. I'll make it a vow instead of a 
wish too!

"...And so, after finishing our shrine 
visit with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi."

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see the news? El Condor Pasa 
really is going to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe this year!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
This news is shocking too! King Halo is 
switching from the classic route to 
sprints... She's running in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Everyone's talking about it even 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The girls in our generation really are 
incredible!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're right.
Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.text:
—Even after the Kikuka Sho, the 
achievements of Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's 
classmates were nothing short of 
remarkable.

One of her classmates, El Condor Pasa, 
achieved a brilliant victory in a GⅠ clash 
against the world's finest Umamusume.

Furthermore, Special Week was also running 
in that race... and despite veering 
off-course midway through, she put on a 
great performance to hold off the Senior 
Umamusume and finish 3rd.

Furthermore, at the end of last year, 
Grass Wonder took 1st place in a GⅠ race 
that gathered the most popular Umamusume.

They say Seiun Sky, who ran in that Kikuka 
Sho, also proved capable of holding his 
own against the Senior class there.

Furthermore, King Halo has announced her 
entry into the 1,200m blitz, showing a 
bold spirit that defies conventional 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, they are all people I respect. 
Always running so far ahead of me.

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi looked up at the sky, 
thinking of the achievements of her 
contemporaries.
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, you can run with them now

Tsuyoshi, you're ready to run with them 
now

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Right! Just like at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That day truly felt like a miracle, like 
a dream..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...I wish I could go back to the day of 
the debut race when I first met you and 
tell myself everything.

On the day I first met Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, 
she was sitting out of the debut selection 
race.

That day when her fellow classmates were 
lining up for their debut races, while she 
alone fell ill and had to sit it out.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...To me, who was always the one left 
behind.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, but right now, you're standing on 
the same line.

Yeah, but right now, you're standing on 
the same line.

text_block_list.text:
"Entering the same gate, running in the 
same race. To such a rival—"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no way! I can't let myself get that 
carried away!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I know where I stand! Including how wide 
the gap between us is."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm lucky enough to get the best gate 
by chance, and if everyone else happens to 
be off their game... I might just win, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, I need to reach a level where I can 
stand shoulder-to-shoulder with everyone 
even without relying on timing.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
First, I have to make the effort just to 
stand beside them!

"She is serious and never lets arrogance 
cloud her view of opponents. While that is 
certainly a virtue..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's take on lots of rivals this year!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yes! Understood!

"What is about to begin is no pretty, 
beautiful dream. —It is possibility, and 
it is a battle."
